title: Single-tape head movement
statement: For natural numbers $c,C$, an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,c\}$, a direction $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and a control state $s$ from the finite control set with copy, setup, loop, rewind, advance, and emit states, define an action on $c+1$ work tapes that leaves the input head stationary, writes nothing on every work tape, moves work-tape head $i$ by $d$ and leaves all other work-tape heads stationary, emits no output, and transitions to state $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a control state indexed by $c,C$
